Repeat the combination every 21 days for up to six cycles, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity. Fluorouracil uses 22 hours each day or the separately prescribed two-infusion alternative described by NCCP. Chemotherapy must start at least one hour after cetuximab ends.

regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Pembrolizumab blocks PD-1, a signal that can limit the activity of immune cells. This can help them attack cancer, but can also cause inflammation in healthy organs during treatment or after it ends. Carboplatin interferes with DNA repair and cell division. Its dose is calculated from kidney function. Blood counts can fall, including platelets that help stop bleeding. It is a different prescription from cisplatin. Fluorouracil interferes with the materials cells need to make DNA and RNA. A pump gives it over the prescribed days. DPD is an enzyme that helps break it down; testing before treatment reduces risk but cannot prevent every severe reaction.

regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Pembrolizumab blocks PD-1, a signal that can limit the activity of immune cells. DPD is an enzyme that helps break it down; testing before treatment reduces risk but cannot prevent every severe reaction.
